quotes.text: 501.    LA SEMANA PASADA, DEL……...........… AL……..…., ¿TUVO UD. ALGÚN TRABAJO? (Sin contar los quehaceres del hogar)
Los quehaceres del hogar no le permiten ............................................. 6

assessments.reasoning: In section 500 (Empleo), Question 501 explicitly excludes unpaid household tasks from the definition of work when asking whether the person had any work in the reference week: '(Sin contar los quehaceres del hogar)'. Furthermore, household chores ('Quehaceres del hogar') are categorized as non-work activities or reasons for not seeking employment (pregunta 546 option 5 and pregunta 549 option 6). Therefore, unpaid domestic and care work is explicitly excluded from the category of work.
